fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Closely-spaced intersection queuing/turning/parking conflicts on a recorded high-accident corridor is a substantive preliminary-design RSA issue with a clear crash-relevant mechanism.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is directly supported by the verbatim EV-US-016 quote ('Queued, turning, and parking vehicles around the closely-spaced intersections at Clear Lake Ave. and the south service road may interfere with each other.'), meeting the quote-required threshold for 2.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a categorical safety_concern with null normative_basis_note under FHWA RSA semantics; no compliance/safety conflation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and actionable (turning-movement restriction plus relocating identified parking stalls outside the intersection functional area) and viable at preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are acknowledged as potentially present on the commercial corridor, but no VRU-specific impact analysis is offered since the mechanism is scoped to vehicle-vehicle interference, fitting the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.

justifications.substance: Queue storage and coordination between signals 650 ft apart on a corridor with recorded high-accident designations is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue with a plausible spillback mechanism.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal spacing claim is supported by a verbatim quote (EV-US-001); the spillback inference and high-accident context are transparently labelled as derived from recorded scheme facts (TABLE A.1 Issue 1) rather than invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern with no compliance conflation; stage-appropriate for preliminary design and categorical separation maintained via null normative basis.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable (signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signing, enhanced conspicuity), viable at preliminary design, and not null.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists at both signals are explicitly acknowledged with a reasoned scoping decision tying exposure to the identified mechanism, demonstrating genuine consideration.
